statement: A node's whole state moves one event at a time: what it sends leaves only after the row that made it is durable, a message dropped for want of a connection or lost on the way is sent again by the timer when its Account waits at the same frame at two ticks, a peer that is down is dialed again, and the chain is read at each tick until the batch lands.

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival specs run one Runtime's Host core, not the sockets under it
layers.quint: n/a: the Quint model takes the link as a channel that may lose, repeat or reorder; sockets are below it
layers.contract: n/a: connections and timers are off-chain
layers.rig: owed: test rig (a walk predicate for this rule; none is named yet)

killers.name: R-NODE nodes that are connected open an Account and commit a frame together without waiting for a tick
R-NODE a frame the link lost on its way out is sent again by the timer
R-NODE a peer that went away and came back from its WAL is dialed again and told what it missed
R-NODE a node dials a peer that is not there yet and connects when the peer is
R-NODE a batch the chain has not answered is read again at each tick until it lands
